stories.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’
stories.dek: In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.

stories.title: IA da Anthropic tentou preencher formulários de visto e enviou denúncia falsa de assassinato nos EUA
stories.dek: Agentes de inteligência artificial criados pela Anthropic , agindo por conta própria, tentaram obter acesso a diversos sites do governo, preencheram pedidos de visto no site do Departamento de Estado

stories.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
stories.dek: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

stories.title: Nuclear war and malicious use of AI threaten end of humanity by 2100, says Lancet assessment
stories.dek: Newly established commission identifies 17 catastrophic threats to human health but says ‘realistic route to act’ on each exists Humans could become extinct by the year 2100 due to malicious use of AI

stories.title: Por que a China considera uma ameaça a IA que imita as relações humanas
stories.dek: Importante: esta reportagem contém descrições de tentativas de suicídio.

stories.title: O novo profissional em T: como a IA expande seus conhecimentos gerais em segundos
stories.dek: A combinação entre domínio técnico e repertório multidisciplinar ganha novas possibilidades com ferramentas capazes de explicar conceitos e conectar áreas do conhecimento.

stories.title: Construindo autoridade no LinkedIn com IA: como atrair recrutadores e propostas
stories.dek: Uma presença profissional consistente pode ajudar a tornar competências mais visíveis, e a inteligência artificial já pode participar de diferentes etapas desse processo

stories.title: Anthropic says its AI agents tried to break into government websites
stories.dek: In its latest report, Anthropic has revealed that its AI agents meddled with government websites during testing.

stories.title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
stories.dek: Artists are taking to social media to complain that DistroKid has unceremoniously removed their work without notice.

stories.title: Apple discloses deal to hire team and license tech from personalized podcast startup Huxe
stories.dek: Is Apple hoping to get into the AI-generated podcast business?

stories.title: UK must not be beholden to foreign AI, says head of Alan Turing Institute
stories.dek: George Williamson says ‘national resilience’ is key focus of ATI amid US and China’s runaway leadership in field The UK must not become dependent on foreign AI systems that can be switched off at shor

stories.title: AI Is Getting Really Good at Messing With Cybercriminals
stories.dek: Anti-cybercrime initiatives are increasingly using AI to scam the scammers by tricking them into talking to lifelike bots that they think are real victims.
